# abox.tools

> Free single-purpose browser tools for local file processing: compress, resize, crop, trim, convert and inspect. No processing uploads or accounts. Intentional browser-to-browser sharing and optional online features are explained on their own pages.

Files are processed on the device running the browser, without processing uploads. Device sharing and live voice/video tools deliberately transmit content between browsers. Optional image imports, receipt exchange-rate lookups and email-app handoffs have their own boundaries. Read the selected tool's page and [Privacy](https://abox.tools/privacy/) for connection modes, relay metadata and optional requests.

The tools need a browser; there is no processing API, CLI or file-upload endpoint. An agent's cloud browser means the file has already left the person's device. The agent provider's access to files, screenshots and instructions is separate from this site's processing. [Can an AI agent use these tools?](https://abox.tools/guides/can-an-ai-agent-use-these-tools/) explains the distinction.

Tools and guides have a Markdown copy: append `index.md` to the page URL, for example https://abox.tools/compress-image/index.md. These copies contain explanations and limitations without the interface. Code is MIT licensed; prose is CC BY 4.0.

This index is generated from the site's configuration and page metadata. It describes available tools; it does not measure whether an AI search system has indexed or cited them.

[Browser workflow skill](https://abox.tools/.well-known/agent-skills/abox-tools/SKILL.md)

## Images

Resize one, shrink one, take out what it quietly records about you, or draw one from nothing - none of it sent anywhere.

- [Image Compressor](https://abox.tools/compress-image/): Compress JPEG, PNG and WebP images to a size you name. The tool searches for the highest quality that fits the target, resizing only when quality alone cannot get there, and measures the result against the original. Runs entirely in the browser with no upload.
- [Image Resizer](https://abox.tools/resize-image/): Resize, crop and convert JPEG, PNG and WebP images in the browser. Set an exact pixel size, a percentage or a long edge, drag a crop box or lock it to a shape, and write the result as JPEG, PNG or WebP. Batches supported, and nothing is uploaded.
- [Image Layout](https://abox.tools/image-layout/): Arrange pictures into a grid, contact sheet or strip with ready-to-use presets, per-image pan and zoom, reordering, size and spacing controls. Preview and save one PNG, JPEG or WebP entirely in the browser.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://abox.tools/heic-to-jpg/): Convert HEIC and AVIF and HEIF photos from an iPhone into JPEG, PNG or WebP. The HEIC decoder is WebAssembly served from the page itself, so the pictures are decoded on your own machine and never uploaded. The date, camera and location can be carried into the JPEG or left out. The metadata checkbox and metadata preview apply only to HEIC; AVIF metadata is always left out.
- [WebP to JPG](https://abox.tools/webp-to-jpg/): Convert WebP and AVIF images to JPG in the browser. The browser's own decoder reads the WebP and its own encoder writes the JPEG, so nothing is uploaded and no codec is downloaded. Transparency is filled with a colour of your choosing, animated WebP files give their first frame, and batches come back as a zip.
- [PNG to WebP](https://abox.tools/png-to-webp/): Convert PNG and AVIF images to WebP in the browser, losslessly or with a quality setting. Transparency is preserved either way, and each result reports which coding the browser actually wrote. Nothing is uploaded and no codec is downloaded.
- [AVIF to JPG](https://abox.tools/avif-to-jpg/): Convert AVIF images to JPG in the browser. The browser's own AVIF decoder reads the file and its own encoder writes the JPEG, so nothing is uploaded and no codec is downloaded. Transparency is filled with a colour of your choosing, and batches come back as a zip.
- [ID Photo Maker](https://abox.tools/id-photo/): Make a passport, visa or ID photograph to a country's published specification in the browser. Applies the print size, DPI, head-height band, eye line and background colour of the chosen document, places the crown, chin and pupils by measuring the picture rather than by running a face model, shows a live overlay and measurement of each, checks the background, lays out a printable 4x6 sheet with cut marks, and writes an upload file at the mandated pixel size inside the portal's KB band. Nothing is uploaded. Each of 73 rules with published figures also has a page of its own stating them, with the authority and the date it was read - https://abox.tools/id-photo/us-passport/ is the United States passport - and the tool's page lists them all.
- [Image Stacker](https://abox.tools/stack-images/): Stack a burst of photographs in the browser: average, median, sigma-clipped mean, lighten, darken, add or focus stack, with the frames aligned first by phase correlation. Reads camera RAW files with usable embedded JPEG previews, without decoding sensor data. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Image Redactor](https://abox.tools/redact-image/): Redact an image in the browser: draw boxes over what should not be seen and black them out, pixelate them or blur them. The covered pixels are overwritten before the file is encoded, so the result carries no layer, no annotation and no metadata. Nothing is uploaded.
- [EXIF Viewer & Remover](https://abox.tools/exif-editor/): Read the EXIF, GPS, XMP and IPTC metadata inside a photo, edit individual tags, or remove all of it in one click. JPEG, PNG and WebP use container edits; AVIF shows available EXIF and cleans to a new PNG in the browser.
- [DICOM Viewer](https://abox.tools/dicom-viewer/): A DCM file opener and DICOM viewer that runs in the browser: CT, MR, X-ray and ultrasound, with window and level, a whole series stacked in order, measurements in millimetres, and every tag in the header. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Image to ICO](https://abox.tools/image-to-ico/): Convert an image into a multi-size Windows ICO file or a macOS ICNS file in the browser. Presets for a website favicon, a Windows application icon and a high-DPI application icon, Apple's ten icns slots, a preview of every size at its real pixel size, and an optional set of the Apple, Android and Windows tile files a website needs. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Image to Data URI](https://abox.tools/image-to-data-uri/): Turn a PNG, JPEG, SVG or WebP into a data URI you can paste into CSS or HTML. UTF-8 SVGs are percent-encoded rather than base64, so they stay readable and shorter. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
- [SVG to Image](https://abox.tools/svg-to-image/): Rasterize an SVG to a PNG, JPEG or WebP at any size, in the browser. Set the size by a multiple, a width, a height, the longest side or a box, add @2x and @3x copies, keep or flatten transparency, and convert a batch at once. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Image to SVG](https://abox.tools/image-to-svg/): Trace a black and white image into an SVG outline in the browser. Thresholds by light and dark or finds the subject against its background, fits curves to the shape, and lets you click away anything that should not be traced. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Height Comparison Chart](https://abox.tools/compare-heights/): Draw a height comparison chart in the browser. Add a man, a woman, a boy, a girl and objects with their heights in centimetres or feet and inches, order them, colour them, and download the result as a PNG or an SVG. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Business Profile Preview](https://abox.tools/business-profile-preview/): Preview a Google Business Profile in the browser. Draws the knowledge panel, the place card on a phone and the local search result from a business name, category, rating, review count, address, phone number, website, description, attributes, opening hours and cover photo, works out the Open or Closed status line from the hours, and downloads the result as a PNG or an SVG. An existing listing can be imported by pasting it, or from a Business Profile API export. Nothing is uploaded.

## Video & animation

Trim, convert or build a clip from photos, with the footage staying on your device.

- [Video Compressor](https://abox.tools/compress-video/): Compress a video to under a chosen number of megabytes in your browser. The tool picks the frame size and bitrate the number allows, encodes H.264 into an MP4 on your machine, copies the sound through, and measures the result. Nothing is uploaded.
- [MP4 Converter](https://abox.tools/convert-to-mp4/): Convert a WebM, MKV, MOV or MP4 into an MP4 with H.264 picture and AAC sound in your browser. Tracks that are already H.264 or AAC are copied across untouched; the rest are re-encoded on your machine. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Video Rotator](https://abox.tools/rotate-video/): Rotate a video a quarter or half turn in your browser. Header rotation copies picture frames unchanged; baking the turn re-encodes the picture for old players. AAC sound is copied, other decodable sound is encoded as AAC, and sound can be omitted. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Images to Video](https://abox.tools/images-to-video/): Turn a folder of images into an MP4 slideshow video. Every step runs in your browser, so no image is ever uploaded.
- [Video Cutter](https://abox.tools/trim-video/): Mark parts to keep or remove and join the rest in your browser. MP4, MOV and M4V support byte-preserving copy when the selected sections and tracks are compatible. Exact cuts re-encode video; recording re-encodes picture and sound. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Video Cropper](https://abox.tools/crop-video/): Crop a video to any shape or exact pixel box in the browser. MP4, MOV and M4V are decoded and re-encoded frame by frame with the original audio carried across untouched; anything else the browser can play is cropped by recording it. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Video Reverser](https://abox.tools/reverse-video/): Reverse a video in the browser, sound included. MP4, MOV and M4V are decoded group by group from the end and encoded again with the original frame times; anything else the browser can play is stepped through backwards instead. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Time-Lapse Maker](https://abox.tools/timelapse-video/): Turn a long video into a time-lapse in the browser. One frame is taken every few seconds of the original and the frames are written back as a short MP4 at 24, 30 or 60 frames a second. MP4, MOV and M4V are read directly and only around the instants that are needed; anything else the browser can play is seeked through instead. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Video Frame Grabber](https://abox.tools/grab-frame/): Save any frame of a video as a full-size PNG, JPEG or WebP in the browser. MP4, MOV and M4V are read frame by frame through WebCodecs so the exact frame asked for is the one saved; anything else the browser plays is captured from the player. Nothing is uploaded.
- [GIF to MP4](https://abox.tools/gif-to-mp4/): Convert an animated GIF to an MP4 in your browser. Every frame keeps the GIF's own delay, the picture stays its own size, and the result is H.264 in an MP4 at a fraction of the GIF's size. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Video to GIF](https://abox.tools/video-to-gif/): Convert a section of a video into an animated GIF in the browser. The frames are sampled at the chosen rate, one 256-colour palette is chosen for the whole animation by median cut, and each frame is written as only the region that changed. Nothing is uploaded.
- [GIF Maker](https://abox.tools/gif-maker/): Turn a set of images into an animated GIF. The frames, the palette and the compression are all worked out in your browser, so no image is ever uploaded.
- [GIF Splitter](https://abox.tools/split-gif/): Split an animated GIF into its frames and save each one as a PNG. The file is decompressed in your browser, so no animation is ever uploaded.
- [GIF Analyzer](https://abox.tools/gif-analyzer/): Take a GIF apart in the browser: every frame with its delay, rectangle and disposal method, the colour tables, the loop count, any metadata, and a byte-by-byte account of the file size. Nothing is uploaded.

## Documents & audio

Rearrange a document or trim a recording without sending either away for processing.

- [PDF Merger & Splitter](https://abox.tools/merge-pdf/): Merge PDFs, split one into several files, and reorder, rotate or remove pages in your browser. Pages are copied between documents locally, so no file is ever uploaded.
- [PDF Compressor](https://abox.tools/compress-pdf/): Compress a PDF in your browser. Images are recompressed against how large they are actually drawn on the page, and the document is rewritten locally, so no file is ever uploaded.
- [PDF Unlocker](https://abox.tools/unlock-pdf/): Remove the password and the printing, copying and editing restrictions from a PDF in your browser. It says which kind of protection the file has and what it was worth, never guesses a password, and nothing is uploaded.
- [PDF Protector](https://abox.tools/protect-pdf/): Password-protect a PDF, or restrict printing, copying and editing, in your browser. AES-256 by default, an older scheme for older readers, nothing uploaded, and the finished file is reopened here to prove the lock holds.
- [PDF Watermark](https://abox.tools/watermark-pdf/): Put a watermark on every page of a PDF in your browser: who the copy is for, a date, a name, at any angle, size and opacity, in any language. The pages are not touched, nothing is uploaded, and the result is reopened to prove every page carries the stamp.
- [PDF Redactor](https://abox.tools/redact-pdf/): Redact a PDF in your browser by deleting the text rather than covering it. The letters are removed from the page's content stream, the finished file is reopened and searched to prove they have gone, and nothing is uploaded.
- [PDF to CSV](https://abox.tools/pdf-to-csv/): Extract text-based PDF tables to CSV in your browser: statements, invoices, price lists and reports. Detection uses readable text positions and may miss unusual layouts; scanned pages need OCR first. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Receipt & Invoice Extractor](https://abox.tools/receipt-invoice-extractor/): Read English receipt and invoice photos locally, review the fields and crops, and prepare compressed JPEG email attachments with each document's amount, the count and a grand total in one final currency using manual or optional historical rates.
- [Images to PDF](https://abox.tools/images-to-pdf/): Combine JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF images into a single PDF document. Every page is written in your browser, so no image is ever uploaded.
- [Document Scanner](https://abox.tools/document-scanner/): Scan a document in the browser: photograph a page, and the four corners are found, the perspective is undone, the uneven light is divided out, and the result is written into a PDF. Multiple pages become one document. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Extract Audio from Video](https://abox.tools/extract-audio-from-video/): Extract the audio track from an MP4, MOV or WebM and save it as a WAV. Only the audio is decoded, the picture is never read, and nothing is uploaded.
- [Audio Trimmer](https://abox.tools/trim-audio/): Mark any number of parts of a recording while it plays, then save those parts as a single file - or cut them out and keep the rest. Cuts land on the exact sample marked, with an optional few-millisecond fade so the joins do not click. Nothing is uploaded and the result is written as a WAV, so nothing is re-encoded.
- [Audio Editor](https://abox.tools/edit-audio/): Reverse an audio track, change its speed with or without moving the pitch, and set its level, in the browser. Works on the audio inside a video too. Nothing is uploaded and the result is written as a WAV, so nothing is re-encoded.

## Text, codes & passwords

Read it, check it, or make it here - no token, no config file and no password on somebody else's server.

- [JSON Formatter](https://abox.tools/json-formatter/): Format and minify JSON, XML, HTML, CSS and YAML, and convert JSON to YAML or XML and back. The parsers run in the browser and nothing is uploaded.
- [YAML to JSON Converter](https://abox.tools/yaml-to-json/): Convert a supported YAML 1.2 subset to JSON and JSON back to YAML in your browser. Anchors, aliases, tags and multiple documents are refused; comments are lost in JSON. Nothing is uploaded.
- [XML Formatter](https://abox.tools/xml-formatter/): Format, indent and minify XML, and convert XML to JSON or JSON to XML. The parser runs in the browser, resolves no external entities, and nothing is uploaded.
- [Text Diff](https://abox.tools/text-diff/): Compare two texts with a line and word diff, side by side or in one column, and download the result as a unified patch. The comparison runs in the browser and nothing is uploaded.
- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder](https://abox.tools/base64/): Encode and decode Base64 in both alphabets, percent-encode a value or a whole URL, escape and unescape HTML entities, hex bytes and backslash escapes. Everything runs in the browser and nothing is uploaded.
- [QR & Barcode Generator](https://abox.tools/qr-barcode/): Generate a QR code or a linear barcode from a string in the browser. QR codes for links, Wi-Fi networks, contact cards, email, SMS, phone numbers and coordinates, with all four error-correction levels; EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, ITF-14, Interleaved 2 of 5, Code 128 and Code 39 barcodes with their check digits. Download as SVG or PNG. Nothing is uploaded.
- [QR & Barcode Reader](https://abox.tools/qr-barcode-reader/): Read a QR code or a linear barcode from an image, a screenshot or a live camera, entirely in the browser. Shows the decoded string and, for links, the host it would reach, before anything is opened. Supports QR versions 1 to 40 with Reed-Solomon error correction, and EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF-14, Interleaved 2 of 5, Code 128 and Code 39. Nothing is uploaded and no camera frame is recorded.
- [Hash & Checksum](https://abox.tools/hash-checksum/): Work out the MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512 checksum of any file in the browser, and compare it against the value a download page published. The file is read in pieces and never uploaded.
- [Password & Passphrase Generator](https://abox.tools/password-generator/): Generate strong random passwords and diceware passphrases in the browser. Characters are drawn with crypto.getRandomValues and words from a bundled 7,776-word EFF list; the page reports the exact entropy of what it made. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is stored.

## Connect devices

Share text and files, talk live, or watch a camera or browser tab on another device. Each tool explains what it sends and how the browsers connect.

- [Share Text & Files](https://abox.tools/share-text/): Share text and files from one browser to another over an end-to-end encrypted WebRTC connection using Direct or optional Cloud relay. Speakable link names, live updates while typing, markdown rendering, and per-reader approval. Nothing is stored on any server; the share ends when the sharer closes the tab.
- [Local Walkie-Talkie](https://abox.tools/walkie-talkie/): Browser-hosted voice from one host to up to ten receive-only browsers, with direct WebRTC audio and secure internet pairing.
- [Voice Oncall](https://abox.tools/voice-oncall/): A browser-hosted live voice pager with nearby discovery, host approval and optional password admission, direct audio and per-participant host controls.
- [Remote Camera](https://abox.tools/remote-camera/): Watch a device camera in another browser with optional viewer approval, camera switching, Direct or optional Cloud relay, microphone audio and viewer activity notifications, without recording.
- [Share a Browser Tab](https://abox.tools/share-tab/): Stream one selected browser tab as encrypted live video to an approved viewer using Direct or optional Cloud relay and internet introductions.

## Optional

Background rather than answers. Skip these if you are short of room.

- [All guides](https://abox.tools/guides/): Plain guides to compressing, resizing, cropping, trimming and converting your own files - what the settings mean, what they cost, and why none of it needs an upload.
- [Roadmap](https://abox.tools/roadmap/): Every tool planned for abox.tools, grouped and in the open, plus the ones already finished. File processing happens in your browser.
- [github.com/A-Box-of-Tools/website](https://github.com/A-Box-of-Tools/website): The site source, tool READMEs, shared parsers and writers, and any bundled engine licences. First-party code is MIT; prose is CC BY 4.0. No JavaScript package installation is needed to build the site.
- [Sitemap](https://abox.tools/sitemap.xml): Pages offered for indexing in maintained languages, with their last modification dates. Frozen, unfinished and deliberately excluded pages are not listed.
- [About abox.tools](https://abox.tools/about/): An independent, self-funded project: 59 tools that run entirely in your browser, the reason they are built that way, how the site pays for itself, and how to check every claim on it for yourself.
- [Contact](https://abox.tools/contact/): How to reach the person who builds abox.tools: one email address, one public issue tracker, what each is best for, and what actually happens when you write.
- [Privacy & Cookies](https://abox.tools/privacy/): Local file processing, deliberate sharing, optional online rates, analytics, browser storage and hosting: what each feature sends and who can see it.
- [Terms of Use](https://abox.tools/terms/): The terms this site is offered under: free, as-is, no account, no warranty, and your files remain entirely your own because they are never sent to us.
